assessments.name: Final Exam - Oral Assessment
assessments.description:
Students will be provided with a clinical scenario describing a disease and treatment plan
5 minutes reading time
10 minute oral exam presenting their plan and communication strategies

assessments.name: Stress management plan
assessments.description: You will select an evidence-based strategy for managing stress and describe how you will put this into practice
assessments.dueRaw: Week 02 Due date : 08 Mar 2026 at 23:00 Closing date : 08 Mar 2026

assessments.name: Team contract
assessments.description: Students will develop a brief team contract to guide how their group will work together on the assignment setting clear expectations for roles, timelines, communication, meeting arrangements, decision-making, and standards for participation
assessments.dueRaw: Week 04 Due date : 22 Mar 2026 at 23:00 Closing date : 22 Mar 2026

assessments.name: Case study presentation
assessments.description:
Groups will be given a patient case study featuring a communication challenge and produce a video
2 people will role play (patient and clinician)
2 people to present case and management plan based on provided guideline
1 person to summarise.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 09 Due date : 03 May 2026 at 23:00 Closing date : 03 May 2026

assessments.name: Final group report
assessments.description: Describe and demonstrate how they worked as a team to present case and management plan; how did they implement their own self-care plan to complete this assessment; relate the key elements of professionalism with how they worked as a team
assessments.dueRaw: Week 11 Due date : 17 May 2026 at 23:00 Closing date : 17 May 2026
